card.name: A Hero Gone Mad
card.rules_text: Return target Hollow card from your graveyard to the battlefield.

card.name: Aldrich, Devourer of Gods
card.rules_text: {B}{B}: Exile target creature card from a graveyard. ~ has all activated abilities of all cards exiled with this ability.
card.flavor_text: A right and proper cleric, with a habit of devouring men.

card.name: Bonfire Ascetic
card.rules_text: Put the top X cards of your library into your graveyard. You lose X life. You get X souls. Choose a creature card in your graveyard. Each other player may choose a number of creatures with total power less than or equal to the chosen creatures power. Return all chosen creatures to the battlefield under their owners control.
card.flavor_text: When the flames grow stronger, so does the curse.

card.name: Carthus Rouge
card.rules_text:
Enchant creature
                  Whenever the enchanted creature deals damage to another creature put two bleed counters on that creature. (As long as a creature has a bleed counter on it that creature has "If this creature is dealt damage it gets a bleed counter. At the beginning of each upkeep deal X damage to this creature where X is the number of bleed counters on it, then remove a bleed counter from it.")

card.name: Charred Knight
card.rules_text: Lifelink. Deathtouch.

card.name: Chosen Undead
card.rules_text:
Target player sacrifices a Legendary creature. If that player doesn't, they sacrifice a creature instead.
                  You get one soul.
                  At the beginning of your upkeep you may pay {1}{B}. If you do, return ~ from your graveyard to your hand.
card.flavor_text: The Unkindled will rise. Nameless, accursed Undead, unfit even to be cinder. And so it is, that ash seeketh embers.

card.name: Clawed Curse
card.rules_text:
Enchant player
              At the beginning of enchanted player's upkeep, that player loses one life and removes one soul.
              Morph {1}{B} (You may cast this card face down as a 2/2 creature for {3}. Turn it face up any time for its morph cost.)
              When ~ is turned face up attach it to target player. That player loses 3 life.

card.name: Curse of the Dead
card.rules_text:
Enchant player
                  Hollow creatures enchanted player controls get -1/-1 and can't block.

card.name: Dark Edge
card.rules_text:
Choose one -
                  Deal 5 damage to player. You gain 5 life.
                  Destroy target nonblack creature. You gain life equal to it's toughness
                  Destroy target planeswalker. You gain life equal to it's loyalty
card.flavor_text: Passed from mother to daughter, this blade was intended for both protection and as a means of taking one's own life. The young girl never swung it more than once.

card.name: Dark Hand of Kaathe
card.rules_text: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. If that creature would die this way, remove two souls from that creature's controller and you get two souls.

card.name: Darkwraith
card.rules_text: {4B}, {T}: Target player loses 3 life. You get three souls.
card.flavor_text: In the blink of an eye the ancients could sap the humanity of the most replete saint.

card.name: Deep Fog
card.rules_text:
Put three bleed counters on each creature. (As long as a creature has a bleed counter on it that creature has "If this creature is dealt damage it gets a bleed counter. At the beginning of each upkeep deal X damage to this creature where X is the number of bleed counters on it, then remove a bleed counter from it.")
                  You lose 3 life.

card.name: Frozen Reindeer
card.rules_text:
Shadow (This creature can block or be blocked by only creatures with shadow.)
                  {T}: Target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn.
card.flavor_text: Prepare yourself, the blizzard is upon us.

card.name: Grave Warden
card.rules_text: ~ can't be blocked as long as you control another black or green permanent.
card.flavor_text: Grave wardens were tasked with disposing of the ever rising corpses that plagued the cathedral. Their clothes are utterly putrid, drenched in the blood and mucilage of their undertaking.

card.name: Grave Warden's Tome
card.rules_text:
You may exile two cards from your hand, or a black card, instead of paying this spell's mana cost.
                  Search your library for a red card and a black card. Reveal them, then put one into your hand and one into your graveyard.
card.flavor_text: High Lord Wolnir succumbed to the Abyss, and discovered the black flame.

card.name: Gravelord Nito
card.rules_text:
When ~ enters the battlefield create ten tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.
                  Whenever a creature dies you get one soul.
card.flavor_text: Nito's soul turned him into a living manifestation of illness and death, a mass of skeletons held together by the miasma of the Death Soul.

card.name: Grip of Death
card.rules_text:
As an additional cost to cast ~, put the top two cards of your library into your graveyard.
                  Destroy target nonzombie, nonhollow creature. You lose 2 life.

card.name: Hollow Soldier
card.rules_text: {B}, exile a creature card from your graveyard: Return ~ from the graveyard to the battlefield. Activate this ability only as a sorcery.

card.name: Hound Rat
card.rules_text: Deathtouch

card.name: Jailer
card.rules_text: {T}: Target creature's toughness becomes 1 until end of turn.

card.name: Lothric Sentry
card.rules_text:
Zombie creatures you control get +1/+1
                  Other Hollow creatures you control get +1/+1

card.name: Necromancer
card.rules_text:
{1}{B}: Create a 1/1 black Skeleton creature token. Activate this ability only during your upkeep.
                  {T}: Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.

card.name: Nimble Shadow
card.rules_text:
Shadow (This creature can block or be blocked by only creatures with shadow.)
                  {T}: Target creature gets a bleed counter. (As long as a creature has a bleed counter on it that creature has "If this creature is dealt damage it gets a bleed counter. At the beginning of each upkeep deal X damage to this creature where X is the number of bleed counters on it, then remove a bleed counter from it.")
card.flavor_text: In an attempt to stave off the curse, King Vendrick hired shadowmen to put down the Hollows, but before long they were Hollowed themselves.

card.name: Parasite Worm
card.rules_text: {G}: Until end of turn whenever ~ deals combat damage to a creature put three bleed counters on that creature. (As long as a creature has a bleed counter on it that creature has "If this creature is dealt damage it gets a bleed counter. At the beginning of each upkeep deal X damage to this creature where X is the number of bleed counters on it, then remove a bleed counter from it.")

card.name: Royal Rat Vanguard
card.rules_text: Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a creature put two bleed counters on that creature. (As long as a creature has a bleed counter on it that creature has "If this creature is dealt damage it gets a bleed counter. At the beginning of each upkeep deal X damage to this creature where X is the number of bleed counters on it, then remove a bleed counter from it.")

card.name: Sift through the Ashes
card.rules_text:
As an additional cost to cast ~ exile X creature cards from your graveyard.
                  You draw X cards, lose X life, and get X souls.

card.name: Skim Memories
card.rules_text:
As an additional cost to cast ~, pay one soul.
                  Target player reveals his or her hand. You may choose a nonland card. That player discards that card.
card.flavor_text: Eventually you'll go hollow. Losing all memories, identity, and your soul.

card.name: The Great Swamp
card.rules_text:
Enchant land
                  Enchanted land has "Each land you control is a Swamp in addition to its other land types. If you would tap a land for {B} it produces {B}{B} and deals 1 damage to you instead.".

card.name: Undead Hound
card.rules_text: Whenever ~ is dealt damage, if that damage was from a source that is red, destroy ~.

card.name: Wake the Hollows
card.rules_text: Exile two target creature cards from your graveyard. Create four 1/1 colorless Hollow creature tokens onto the battlefield.
